name: Notion
description: Search and organize Notion workspace content, capture conversations as documentation, prepare meeting materials, synthesize research, and turn specifications into plans and tasks.
authorization.title: Authorize your Notion account
authorization.description: After an administrator configures an OAuth client, each user signs in and authorizes through Notion. Accessible content depends on that user's workspace permissions.
configuration.endpoint.label: MCP service URL
configuration.endpoint.description: Keep the default URL for Notion's official remote MCP service.
configuration.clientId.label: OAuth Client ID
configuration.clientId.description: Client ID registered with Notion MCP using the Poco backend callback URL. See SETUP.md in this package.
configuration.clientSecret.label: OAuth Client Secret
configuration.clientSecret.description: Secret for the same client, registered with client_secret_basic authentication. Poco stores this value encrypted.
capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.capture.title: Knowledge capture
capabilities.capture.description: Turn discussions into wiki pages, FAQs, guides, or decision records, and connect them to existing content.
capabilities.meeting.title: Meeting preparation
capabilities.meeting.description: Find project context and past notes to prepare internal pre-reads and meeting agendas.
capabilities.research.title: Research documentation
capabilities.research.description: Combine information from multiple pages into summaries, comparisons, or research reports with source links.
capabilities.spec.title: Implementation planning
capabilities.spec.description: Read specifications, define tasks and acceptance criteria, and save plans, tasks, and progress in Notion.
limits.title: Usage scope
limits.description: Creation, updates, and comments require confirmation. Search and data source queries depend on Notion permissions and plan. Wait for async writes to finish; do not resubmit writes with uncertain results.
examples.title: Examples
examples.capture.title: Capture a decision
examples.capture.description: Turn our technical discussion into a decision record in the Notion project wiki and link related pages.
examples.meeting.title: Prepare a project meeting
examples.meeting.description: Use the project updates in Notion to prepare an internal pre-read and agenda for tomorrow's review.
examples.research.title: Synthesize research
examples.research.description: Find customer feedback in Notion, identify common issues, and create a research report with source links.
examples.spec.title: Break down a specification
examples.spec.description: Read this Notion specification, create an implementation plan, and add tasks, owners, and acceptance criteria to the task database.
